messages:
alex: Heads-up — p95 for `chat/high-priority` jumped from ~120ms -> ~260ms after yesterday's batcher tweak. Looks like bigger microbatches getting formed for tier=gold and that's pushing queue wait.

maya: ugh. saw a few of those traces. Is kernel selection also shifting when token_count_per_batch > 1024?

joel: yeah, profiling shows a sharp perf cliff on A100 when total_tokens_per_batch crosses ~1k. Kernel switches to fallback matmul path, cpu->gpu memcpy increases.

li: attaching quick summary: perf-bot ran targeted traces on gold route. Link: https://internal.perf/1850001234/results (perm: eng-runtime)

perf-bot: profile run complete. Highlights:
- median kernel time stable
- p95 spike correlates w/ queue_time and kernel fallbacks
- KV cache hit rate unchanged

alex: so KV cache not to blame. That leaves batching heuristics + dynamic token budgets. We increased global token_budget to reduce padding; maybe that made route-level budgets too permissive.

maya: idea: enforce per-route token_budget_target = min(global, tier_budget[gold]) and add a soft cap that prefers earlier dispatch if queue_time > target_slo/2.

joel: proposed queue policy pseudocode:
```
if queue_time > p95_slo * 0.5:
  dispatch_if(total_tokens_in_queue >= min(token_budget_target, low_threshold))
else:
  continue forming up to token_budget_target
```
This reduces tail by prioritizing latency under pressure.

li: also worth trying kernel-prefetch hint: when predicted_total_tokens > 900, pre-select optimized kernel path earlier to avoid fallback. That trick reduced p95 by ~20ms in local tests.

alex: can we run an A/B rollout? Canary 5% of gold traffic with: token_budget_target = route_budget * 0.7 + dynamic_queue_preempt. Collect p95, queue_time, kernel_switch_rate.

maya: +1. Add a guard for microbatch size <= 512 for chat routes with short contexts. Avoid huge microbatches for short sessions.

joel: I'll create a perf job that runs across p4 and v100 fleets and captures kernel id, total_tokens, queue_time, dispatch_reason. Want the log format to be compact: `ts route tier tot_tokens kernel_id q_time dispatch_reason`.

li: if rollout looks good, we should expose route-level budget override in Console so support/product can tweak without deploy.

alex: agreed. Action items:
- joel: perf job + canary config (ETA EOD)
- maya: implement queue_time preempt policy in batcher (ETA tomorrow)
- li: kernel-prefetch patch + local A100 smoke (ETA tomorrow)
- i'll track canary metrics and hold rollback if p95 regresses > 10%

maya: FYI leaving a short note in release channel once canary config is live. :thumbsup:

joel: starting perf job now, posting results when finished.

perf-bot: perf job started (id=185000-rt1). Will post results to thread when done.
